text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 4340 Bloor Street West.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 25, 2017, regarding the property located at 4340 Bloor Street West, for Items 1 to 6 inclusive, and in doing so granted an extension of time for Item 4 only to May 31, 2018, with a provision that the garbage bins are to be kept closed at all times.
